issues.description: Constructors for animal subclasses (Seal, Pig, Goat): the template's commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java uses two-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), but the problem statement and UML define animals with a single attribute (name) and the solution implementation uses single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal(String name)). This disagreement over constructor parameters can confuse students about the required constructor signatures and lead to incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example consistent with the UML and solution. Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use single-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")) so it matches the single 'name' attribute described in the problem statement and implemented in the solution. If instead a second attribute was intended, update the UML/problem statement to document the extra attribute and update the solution and template to implement two-argument constructors accordingly. Preferred fix: change the template Main to single-argument constructors.
